obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived conditional relation with bounded correspondence only; no universal formal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Sufficient allocation, standard Rust semantics, stated valid endpoint and arithmetic domains.
obernants.domain: Finite named test fixtures and terminating candidate implementations.
obernants.operator: For fixed finite fixtures, U consists of candidate terminating implementations paired with claimed pass/fail outcomes. R pairs each with conjunction of actual assertions. U minus R contains false pass and false failure claims. Unexercised inputs are unconstrained; a passing suite is not universal correctness.

obernants.operator: The oracle follows parent chains and detects repeats with linear membership, then intersects ancestor vectors. It does not use depths, binary lifting or production state flags. All (n+1)^n parent functions for n=1..5 are inspected.
